_comment: GUT 9.6.1 configuration for G-PID. / G-PID 的 GUT 9.6.1 配置。
dirs: scan res://tests (GPGTest suites live there; GUT-native tests under res://tests/gut).
include_subdirs: true so res://tests/gut/test_gp_suites.gd (the GPGTest bridge) is picked up.
prefix/suffix: only test_*.gd are GUT scripts; gp_test_*.gd are driven by the bridge instead.
CLI flags override these values, e.g. -gjunit_xml_file=... in CI. / CI 中的命令行参数可覆盖本文件。
